content_sections.heading: CSB BTSSO Sericulture Assistant Vacancy Details (Centre-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 15 vacancies are available across various institutes, units, and offices under the Basic Tasar Silkworm Seed Organization.

content_sections.heading: CSB BTSSO Sericulture Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Work experience in the field of silkworm rearing & grainage (Pre-Cocoon Sector).

rows.qualification_required: Candidates must possess any one of the following qualifications from a recognized university or institution: Sericulture (Sericulture) in three or four-year full-time degree, OR Three-year full-time degree + PG Diploma in Sericulture, OR Agriculture Sciences/Forestry in four-year full-time bachelor degree, OR Biological Science (Zoology or Botany or Biology) in three-year full-time degree + PG Diploma in Sericulture, OR Biological Sciences (Zoology or Botany or Biology) in three-year full-time bachelor degree or Biotechnology + One year experience in Sericultural project work.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central Silk Board, Basic Tasar Silkworm Seed Organization (BTSSO), Bilaspur under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSB BTSSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are available for the post of Sericulture Assistant (SA).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 3/4-year full-time degree in Sericulture, Agriculture Sciences/Forestry, or Biological Sciences (with specified PG Diploma or project work experience) as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the cut-off date of 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration for Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 21,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on the performance of eligible candidates in a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this engagement is purely temporary and contractual for an initial period of one year, and it does not confer any right to regularisation or permanent employment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal at https://csb-hiring.in.
